text:
sofia: Starting a follow-up thread for yesterday's KV shard OOM storm. We need single-point owners and short, testable mitigations. Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/pm/kv-oom-2026-03-22

raj: I'll own the profiler and reproducible heap captures. Plan: enable continuous pprof on canaries, 30s heap snapshots on spikes, and capture jemalloc stats. Opening INF-4901. ETA Fri (2026-03-26).

tara: I'll run eviction policy experiments and own the alert threshold PR. Experiment matrix: LRU, size-weighted, and TTL-priority. Will build a harness that can inject long-lived keys. INF-4905. ETA Mon (2026-03-29).

mike: I'll prototype GC/allocator knobs. First pass: adjust slab granularity, bump incremental GC frequency, and test --max-inflight-keys=limit. Sharing config diff and microbench results. INF-4908. ETA Mon (2026-03-29).

ops-bot: Reminder: "KV OOM remediation sync" on 2026-03-24 17:00 UTC.

raj: Need a tiny sampling script to emit residency histograms and per-key age percentiles every 60s. Adding to INF-4901.

sofia: Alert change proposal: soft-alert at 85% usage, hard at 95%. @tara please PR against monitoring with dashboard snapshots.

tara: Will do. Dashboard will include correlated heap pprof snapshot markers and reroute events.

jen: I can spin up temporary Dedicated capacity for canaries (cluster: dedicated-east-2). Ping when ready.

raj: I'll add a CI regression that replays a sticky-residency workload (long-lived prefixes + bursts) so we catch growth regressions. Prototype PR by Fri.

mike: If eviction experiments don't mitigate tails, short-term mitigator: enable eviction-probation + lower TTLs for non-essential keys. Canary-first rollout.

sofia: Action list summary:
- INF-4901 profiling + pprof captures (raj) - due 2026-03-26
- INF-4905 eviction experiments + alert PR (tara) - due 2026-03-29
- INF-4908 GC/config tuning (mike) - due 2026-03-29
- CI regression for sticky residency (raj) - due 2026-03-26
- Dedicated canary capacity (jen) - on-demand, coord with raj
- Postmortem doc updated with actions + timelines (sofia) - due 2026-03-27

tara: Added note — avoid large reroutes during peak eviction windows (we saw correlation in two incidents). I'll add to runbook.

raj: Will include jemalloc mallctl dumps and jeprof heatmaps in the initial snapshot attachment.

mike: Core capture quick commands for triage: `sudo gcore -o /tmp/core.$(date +%s) $PID` then `pprof --text /path/to/binary /tmp/core.<ts>`. Paste into INF-4908 when used.

sofia: Thanks. If anyone gets blocked, call me. We'll use the sync to reassign overdue items.
